metaDescription: Festive Holiday Lighting won Hamilton's 2026 award. WSIB-compliant, $5M insured, covering seasonal, permanent LED and interior holiday decorating.
summary: Festive Holiday Lighting is a fully insured, WSIB-compliant holiday and permanent lighting company based in Hamilton, with more than 10 years of experience and a 5.0-star rating across 47-plus verified reviews. The company serves the Hamilton-Niagara corridor with both seasonal and year-round lighting.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Festive Holiday Lighting installs seasonal Christmas light displays as well as year-round, app-controlled RGBW permanent LED roofline systems, giving customers a choice between an annual display and a permanent installation. Municipal and BIA lighting and commercial installation extend the company's work into business districts, alongside residential lighting. Interior holiday decorating is also offered, which is a broader scope than most exterior-only lighting installers.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company is fully insured with $5 million in liability coverage and is WSIB-compliant, which matters for any work involving roofline and ladder access at a customer's home. Mid-season maintenance is included, so a failed section of lighting during the holidays is addressed rather than left unresolved. More than 10 years of experience and 47-plus verified reviews at a 5.0-star average give the company one of the stronger review records in the category.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One customer said the team transformed their home and that neighbours knocked on their door asking for the company's number, calling the whole process easy. Another family, in their third year using the company, said the crew always remembers their preferences, arrives on time, and the display gets better every year.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Festive Holiday Lighting is based in Hamilton and serves Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga, Brampton, Ancaster, Grimsby, St. Catharines and Niagara Falls. Homeowners outside this corridor should confirm coverage before booking.

strengths: Fully insured with $5 million liability coverage and WSIB compliance for roofline and ladder work.
5.0-star rating across more than 47 verified reviews.
Offers both seasonal Christmas lighting and permanent, app-controlled RGBW roofline systems.
Serves a wide Hamilton-Niagara corridor including municipal and BIA lighting.
considerations: A wide service area across eight named cities means confirming coverage for your specific address.
Interior decorating and permanent lighting add scope and cost beyond a basic exterior light package.
As with any holiday lighting company, peak-season booking windows fill up early.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting a fully insured, WSIB-compliant installer
Anyone comparing seasonal Christmas lighting against a permanent RGBW system
Municipalities or BIAs needing commercial holiday lighting
Households wanting interior decorating alongside exterior lights
questionsToAsk: Can I see proof of your $5 million liability coverage and WSIB clearance?
How does pricing compare between a seasonal display and the permanent RGBW system?
What is included in mid-season maintenance, and how fast is a repair typically scheduled?
Do you offer interior decorating as a standalone service or only alongside exterior lighting?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Festive Holiday Lighting was selected as the top business in the Holiday & Christmas Lighting category for Hamilton through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do they offer permanent lighting, not just seasonal?
faq.a: Yes. Permanent Holiday Lighting, described as an app-controlled RGBW roofline system, is listed alongside seasonal Christmas Light Installation.

faq.q: Are they insured for roofline work?
faq.a: The company describes itself as fully insured with $5 million in liability coverage and WSIB-compliant, which is worth confirming directly for your project.
Festive Holiday Lighting serves Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga, Brampton, Ancaster, Grimsby, St. Catharines and Niagara Falls.
